title: EU condemns attacks by violent settlers, including on diplomats, spokesperson says
gist: The EU strongly condemned violent settler attacks in the West Bank, including on European diplomats, a day after Belgium's foreign minister said settlers attacked Palestinians, diplomats and a French mayor. The EU expects accountability and preventive measures.

insights.claim: The EU strongly condemned attacks by violent settlers in the West Bank, including against European diplomats.
insights.so_what: Rising EU rhetoric on settler violence adds diplomatic pressure on Israel.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: Belgian Foreign Minister Maxime Prevot said settlers attacked Palestinian civilians, European diplomats and a French mayor in the occupied West Bank.
insights.so_what: Attacks on European officials raise the chance of concrete EU measures.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: The EU noted Israeli officials' condemnations but expects full accountability and effective measures to prevent violence, including during the olive harvest and against journalists.
insights.so_what: Watch for EU follow-through such as sanctions on settlers.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
